input.notes: Checkout button does nothing on the second click in Safari, cart total shows 0. Tried 5 times, happened 3 times. Works fine in Chrome. Staging checkout page.

report.title: Second checkout click is ignored and cart total resets to 0 in Safari
report.environment_details: Device: Desktop; OS: macOS 14; Browser/App: Safari 17; Build/Env: 2.8.1; URL: https://staging.aurora-shop.dev/checkout
steps_to_reproduce: Sign in to Aurora Storefront on Safari 17 and add two items to the cart
Click the Checkout button once and wait for the spinner to stop
Click the Checkout button a second time
Read the cart total in the order summary panel
report.actual_result: The second click does nothing: the page stays on /checkout, no request is sent, and the order summary total changes to 0.00. No error message is shown.
report.expected_result: The second click is ignored safely or re-submits the order, the total keeps its real value, and the shopper is taken to the payment step.
report.suggested_fix: Disable the Checkout button until the first request resolves, and keep the cart total in state instead of re-reading it from the cleared response.
report.business_impact: High - shoppers on Safari cannot complete payment and abandon the order; roughly a fifth of desktop checkout traffic is affected.
report.affected_users: Desktop shoppers using Safari 17 on macOS
report.regression_risk: Medium - the checkout button handler is shared with the saved-cart flow
report.workaround: Reload the checkout page and click Checkout once, without double-clicking.
screenshot_annotations: Order summary panel showing a total of 0.00 after the second click
Network tab showing only one POST to /api/checkout
Console showing an unhandled promise rejection
report.suspected_pattern: Race Condition - the second click fires while the first checkout request is still in flight, and the handler clears the cart state before the response arrives.
related_issues: Cart badge keeps the old item count after the total resets
No error message is shown when a checkout request is dropped
investigation_steps: Check the browser console for an unhandled promise rejection on the second click
Inspect the network tab for a second POST to /api/checkout that never leaves
Query the staging order service logs for a dropped checkout request
Try the same flow in Chrome and Firefox to confirm it is Safari only
Add a temporary log around the cart-total reducer to see what clears it
